long_biography.plain_text:
Jewellery was already a family trade when Martens entered it. His grandfather Jean had opened a gold, silver and watch shop, while his father Leon established the Maastricht house that bears his name. In 1975 Luud and Marie-Louise assumed leadership, pairing traditional craftsmanship and service with a sharper focus on international luxury brands.

The pivotal expansion came when the Martens family acquired Schaap en Citroen, giving the Maastricht business a national platform. Martens helped steer the chain toward the upper end of watches and jewellery, with specialist boutiques and stronger positions for leading Swiss maisons. His sons Lex and Dennis now direct the enterprise, continuing a fourth generation of family control while their father remains its owner and a visible figure in Maastricht's business community.
